name: Cucumber Tomato Kachumber
description: A crisp everyday salad with cucumber, tomato, onion, cumin and plenty of lime.
steps: Dice the cucumber and tomato into similarly small pieces.
Add red onion and coriander to a serving bowl.
Season with cumin, chilli, pepper, salt and lime juice.
Toss gently and serve immediately so the vegetables stay crisp.

name: Mint Curd Raita
description: Cooling cucumber yogurt with mint and roasted cumin for curries, rice bowls or wraps.
steps: Whisk the yogurt until smooth and lightly aerated.
Squeeze excess water from the grated cucumber.
Fold cucumber, mint, coriander, cumin and chilli into the yogurt.
Season with lemon, pepper and salt, then chill until serving.

name: Jeera Roasted Potatoes
description: Golden potato cubes with cumin, turmeric and lemon—an easy side for almost any main.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a small tray.
Toss potatoes with oil, cumin, turmeric, coriander, chilli and salt.
Roast for 24-26 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh coriander before serving.

name: Garlic Lemon Green Beans
description: Bright green beans lightly blistered with garlic, lemon and cracked black pepper.
steps: Steam the green beans for 3 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
Heat oil in a wide pan and toast the sliced garlic lightly.
Add beans and cook over high heat for 4 minutes until blistered.
Turn off the heat and toss with lemon, parsley, pepper and salt.

name: Turmeric Cabbage Peas
description: Quick shredded cabbage and peas with mustard seeds, turmeric and curry leaves.
steps: Heat oil and crackle mustard seeds with curry leaves and chilli.
Add cabbage, peas, turmeric and a small pinch of salt.
Stir-fry over medium-high heat for 7 minutes, keeping some crunch.
Finish with lemon and coriander and serve warm.

name: Masala Roasted Cauliflower
description: Crisp-edged cauliflower florets with paprika, cumin and turmeric.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and dry the cauliflower thoroughly.
Toss florets with oil, paprika, cumin, turmeric, garlic, pepper and salt.
Spread in one layer and roast for 20-22 minutes, turning once.
Add lemon and coriander while hot and serve immediately.

name: Beetroot Carrot Kosambari
description: Fresh grated vegetables, soaked moong dal and coconut in a lime-tempered salad.
steps: Soak moong dal in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain well.
Combine beetroot, carrot, drained dal, coconut and coriander.
Heat oil and crackle mustard seeds with a little chilli.
Pour over the salad, add lime and salt and toss evenly.

name: Sesame Ginger Broccoli
description: Tender-crisp broccoli with ginger, a light soy glaze and toasted sesame.
steps: Steam broccoli for 4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Warm sesame oil and ginger in a pan for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and soy sauce and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Finish with sesame seeds, spring onion, lime, chilli and pepper.

name: Spiced Sweet Potato Wedges
description: Baked sweet-potato wedges with smoky cumin, paprika and fresh lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and cut sweet potato into even wedges.
Toss with oil, paprika, cumin, garlic, chilli and salt.
Arrange cut-side down and bake for 24-26 minutes, turning once.
Squeeze over lime and scatter with coriander before serving.

name: Garlic Herb Mushrooms
description: Juicy browned mushrooms with garlic, thyme, parsley and black pepper.
steps: Heat a wide pan until very hot and add the mushrooms dry.
Cook for 4 minutes until their water evaporates and edges begin to brown.
Add oil, garlic and thyme and saute for another 3 minutes.
Finish with parsley, lemon, pepper, chilli and salt.

name: Tandoori Roasted Carrots
description: Sweet roasted carrots with warm tandoori spices, coriander and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a small baking tray.
Toss carrot batons with oil, paprika, cumin, garam masala, garlic and salt.
Roast for 20-22 minutes, turning once, until browned and tender.
Finish with lemon and coriander and serve warm.

name: Palak Corn Sauté
description: Fast garlicky spinach and sweet corn with cumin and a touch of tomato.
steps: Heat oil and toast cumin and garlic until fragrant.
Add tomato and corn and cook over high heat for 3 minutes.
Fold in spinach by handfuls until just wilted.
Season with chilli, pepper, salt and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Charred Capsicum Corn Salad
description: Smoky peppers and sweet corn tossed with red onion, coriander and lime.
steps: Heat a grill pan until smoking hot and lightly oil the capsicum.
Char capsicum for 5 minutes and add corn for the final 2 minutes.
Transfer to a bowl with red onion and coriander.
Season with lime, cumin, chilli and salt and toss well.

name: Herb Roasted Pumpkin
description: Caramelized pumpkin with rosemary, thyme, pepper and crunchy pumpkin seeds.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and dry the pumpkin cubes well.
Toss pumpkin with oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic, pepper and salt.
Roast for 24 minutes, turning once, until caramelized at the edges.
Scatter with pumpkin seeds and lemon zest before serving.

name: Cumin Carrot Peas
description: A colourful everyday side of tender carrots and peas with cumin and lemon.
steps: Steam diced carrots for 4 minutes so they begin to soften.
Heat oil and toast cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add carrots, peas, turmeric, chilli and salt and saute for 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon and coriander while the vegetables are bright.

name: Tangy Red Cabbage Slaw
description: Crunchy purple cabbage, carrot and apple in a fresh lime dressing without mayonnaise.
steps: Shred cabbage as finely as possible and place in a bowl.
Add carrot, apple and coriander.
Whisk oil, lime, ginger, pepper and salt into a dressing.
Massage through the vegetables for 30 seconds and serve crisp.

name: Tomato Basil White Beans
description: Creamy white beans with burst tomatoes, garlic and basil for a simple protein side.
steps: Heat oil and soften garlic without letting it brown.
Add tomatoes and chilli and cook for 4 minutes until some burst.
Fold in white beans and warm gently for another 4 minutes.
Turn off the heat and add basil, lemon, pepper and salt.

name: Peanut Lime Zucchini
description: Tender-crisp zucchini with roasted peanuts, chilli, coriander and lime.
steps: Heat a wide pan, add oil and toast cumin with chilli.
Add zucchini in one layer and cook over high heat for 5 minutes.
Season with pepper and salt while keeping the centres tender-crisp.
Turn off the heat and toss with peanuts, coriander and lime.

name: Curry Leaf Coconut Beans
description: South Indian-style green beans with coconut, mustard seeds and fragrant curry leaves.
steps: Heat oil and crackle mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli.
Add chopped beans, salt and water and cover for 6 minutes.
Remove the lid and cook until the water evaporates and beans are tender.
Fold in coconut and lime and warm for one final minute.

name: Lemon Pepper Asparagus
description: Quick roasted asparagus with lemon zest, parsley and plenty of cracked pepper.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and dry the asparagus spears.
Toss with oil, garlic, pepper, chilli and salt.
Roast in one layer for 8-10 minutes until bright and tender.
Finish with lemon zest, juice and parsley before serving.
